title: FanzyZones: Spacing always applied (even if disabled) to Grid after latest update

steps: Disable Show space around zones in Grid, save, and record editor model values plus serialized applied/custom layout UUID, ShowSpacing and Spacing.
Drag a normal window into the active layout and compare actual zone geometry with the selected monitor/desktop binding and native loaded values.
